name: openfermion-sdrift-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is OpenFermion, a Python library for compiling and analyzing quantum
algorithms that simulate fermionic systems: fermion and qubit operators, transforms between them,
measurement-partitioning schemes, lattice models and model Hamiltonians.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is OpenFermion's operator utilities, transforms, measurement partitioning and Hamiltonian models: every module under src/openfermion/utils/, src/openfermion/measurements/, src/openfermion/transforms/ (with its opconversions/ and repconversions/ subpackages) and src/openfermion/hamiltonians/, together with src/openfermion/config.py, and the module, class and function docstrings of these modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is the in-package
docstrings of the in-scope modules, including their examples; in-package code comments are only
supporting evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.12 with no network access. openfermion is imported from `/workdir/src`
(it is on `PYTHONPATH`); its runtime dependencies (cirq-core, numpy, scipy, sympy, networkx, h5py and
